name: Product ladder
oneLiner: 3 to 5 glass steps rise left to right, each carrying a floating glass glyph tile with its name and price on the step's face; a lit puck hops up the steps one by one, each one ringing with light as it lands, and the top tile floods with the accent
say: when the speaker walks up a range of options from cheap to best ('instant coffee, then beans, then a grinder, then the espresso machine'): the puck lands on each as it is named, the top one lights on the final pick
